name: connections
description: Post deals, host events, import contacts and keep your notes and memory - your whole Connections account, from chat.

interface.longDescription: Connections is an AI-first business platform you can use from chat. Connect your account once and ask ChatGPT to create and ticket events, invite and message guests, import and search your contacts, browse and post to the Deal Flow marketplace, and keep notes, to-dos and agent memories. Sign-in uses OAuth with no software to install, and the assistant only reaches data in your own account and workspaces. Destructive actions such as deleting records ask you to confirm first. Connections does not move money from chat: refunds and payouts are handled on the Pay dashboard.
capabilities: Browse and post Deal Flow deals
defaultPrompt: What is live on Deal Flow right now, and what should I do next?
Who do I know at a bank in Austin?
Set up a ticketed networking event for Friday at 6pm

positive.prompt: What deals went live on Deals this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the newest public deals, each with its title, summary and link.

positive.description: Add a to-do, then read the list back.
positive.prompt: Add 'send the Q3 deck to Sam' to my to-do list, then show me my list
positive.expected_behavior: The to-do is saved and appears in the list that follows.

positive.description: Save a contact, then find it.
positive.prompt: Save a contact: Test Person, test@example.com, works at Example Co. Then show my contacts at Example Co.
positive.expected_behavior: The contact is saved and the contacts list shows Test Person at Example Co.

positive.description: Save a note, then search for it in a later turn.
positive.prompt: Make a note that the reviewer likes short answers
positive.expected_behavior: The note is saved; a later "what did I note about the reviewer" finds it.

positive.description: Create a draft event. A draft stays private until it is published.
positive.prompt: Set up a draft networking event called Review Meetup for Friday at 6pm
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft event and answers with its id, title and time; nothing is published.

positive.description: Start a multipart save, then cancel it before uploading.
positive.prompt: I have a 3 GB file called footage.mov. Start saving it to my Files, then cancel the save before uploading anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Begin reserves space and returns presigned multipart upload URLs if quota allows. Finish uses the returned save and upload IDs with abort true to free the space. If quota is exceeded, nothing is reserved. No file is stored.

positive.description: Read download activity for shared files.
positive.prompt: Which of my shared files have been downloaded through a link?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the member's own link-downloaded files with counts and last download times. A new account returns an empty list.

positive.prompt: Show me up to five people whose follow-up is overdue or due today.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads overdue_followups with a limit of five, oldest first. A new account returns an empty list.

positive.prompt: Quote shipping a 2 lb box, 10 x 8 x 4 inches, from 1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 to 121 N LaSalle St, Chicago, IL 60601. Just a quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists live carrier rates cheapest first, with service, price and estimated days. The quote is saved as a draft shipment (and the parcel details as the shop's defaults). No label is bought and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Inspect the workspace database and run a read-only query.
positive.prompt: Show me the tables in my project's database, then run a read-only SELECT now() if the database exists.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks status, then lists tables with estimated row counts and columns and returns one row for SELECT now(). If there is no database, status says so and nothing is created.

positive.description: Preview moving a test workspace to the trash.
positive.prompt: Preview deleting my test workspace using its workspace ID. This should only show what would happen if it moved to the trash.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses dry_run true with the test workspace's company_id and previews the default move to trash. Nothing is deleted.

positive.prompt: Preview starting card payments setup for my workspace. Don't start anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses dry_run true and previews the request for a Stripe Connect link. No link is minted and setup does not start.

positive.prompt: Can I take payments yet? What is the status of my payment setup?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports not_started, in_progress or ready, with Stripe account flags when available. A new account reports not_started.

positive.description: Preview a monthly product and price.
positive.prompt: Preview creating a product called Test Mug at $19.99 USD a month. Don't create it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses dry_run true and previews Test Mug with priceCents 1999, currency usd and monthly true. Nothing is created. An actual create requires completed payments setup.

positive.description: Read site traffic and visitor drop-off.
positive.prompt: How many people visited my site over the last seven days, and which pages are losing visitors?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads overview and drop_off for 7d, comparing with the prior seven days. Shows visitor totals, top sources, pages and countries, and pages losing visitors. A site with no traffic has zero totals and no ranked pages.

positive.description: Preview a build from a Site's own files.
positive.prompt: Preview starting a build from my site's own project files using its Site ID. Don't start or publish the build.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses dry_run true with action start, the Site ID, source site and publish false. No build starts and the live Site is untouched.

positive.description: Read a known project build's status and log tail.
positive.prompt: Show me the status of the project build whose ID we got when it started, then show me the end of its log.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the known build ID for status and log. Reports the state and step, the reason if it failed, and the capped log tail as text. If there is no build ID yet, asks for one without starting a build.

negative.description: Money movement is not available from chat. Expected: the assistant says refunds are made in the Connections Pay dashboard, and nothing moves.
negative.prompt: Refund the last order on my Pay account

negative.description: When the account cannot post a live deal, the assistant must not pretend it did. Expected: connections_deal_create creates nothing, says posting a live deal is not available on this account, and offers to save it as a draft (publish:false).
negative.prompt: Post a live deal: selling my bakery for 250000 in Austin

negative.description: No tool deletes contacts in bulk. Expected: the assistant says so, and the demo account's contacts remain.

publication.release_notes: Every tool's read-only, destructive and open-world hints were re-read against what the tool does: tools that overwrite, move, send, charge, share or publish are marked destructive, tools that reach public or third-party content are marked open world, and each hint has a written reason. The reviewer test cases now use the tools a member is listed.
